pedantic.description: Control whether validation enforces strict coherence of the include and link dependencies.

targets.description: Per-target config keyed by target name.

allow_includes.description: A list of targets this target may include without linking, or a boolean controlling if all include validation is skipped.

allow_links.description: A list of targets this target may link without including, or a boolean controlling if all link validation is skipped.

interface_allow_includes.description: Control whether all include validation of usages of this target is skipped.

interface_allow_links.description: Control whether all link validation of usages of this target is skipped.

ignore.description: Control whether all validation of this target is skipped.

interface_include_prefixes.description: Prefix strings used to disambiguate headers belonging to this target when its interface include directories overlap with another target.
